provider_manifestation.rights_statement: Provider states the ASJP Database is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).

deduplication.canonicalization_rule: ASJP language page, downloadable/exported representations, mirrors and citations of the same ASJP Mundari wordlist are one database record; Peiros 1998 remains an upstream source dependency and is not silently treated as independently verified evidence.

scope.classification: direct Mundari linguistic resource with upstream dependency
scope.reason: The provider explicitly identifies the record as Mundari (unr; mund1320), but its listed lexical source is Peiros 1998 and therefore provenance must remain visible.

promotion.status: canonical licensed dataset record established; item-level lexical promotion withheld pending deterministic extraction and upstream-source audit

gates: Capture the exact ASJP wordlist/export deterministically and preserve stable item identifiers/locators before lexical evidence promotion.
Verify whether individual lexical content has additional upstream-source attribution or licensing constraints beyond the database-level CC BY 4.0 statement.
Audit Peiros 1998 as the provider-listed upstream source and do not count ASJP-derived entries as independent corroboration of Peiros.
Do not generalize database coordinates or provider-reported speaker counts into contemporary cultural/geographic claims without source-specific verification.
Preserve provider orthography/transcription exactly; do not silently normalize forms across dialects or scripts.
audit_note: Run 561 converts a previously unregistered licensed Mundari lexical-dataset lead into a canonical source audit. It is intentionally not discovery-only, because a stable provider-level identity, language identifiers, source dependency and rights statement are now fixed; proposition/item-level evidence awaits deterministic wordlist extraction and provenance review.
